notes.title: Demo 2.2 Version Update Added controller support and SteamDeck compatibility.
notes.content:
New Features

Demo 2.2 Version Update
Added controller support and SteamDeck compatibility. You can now play the game on handheld devices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/20380f58cc8b20711678a811cd38c5090be60b86.jpg[/img]

Click to Move Added
You can now click on the scene to move your character directly with the mouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/283e9f0d625d683618d84436d21f760303264785.jpg[/img]

Event Log Added
You can now view previous conversation records and information at any time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/9283802ac733410d7eedda53a899830f01d337b4.png[/img]

Enemy Movement Range Preview Added in Battle
Attack range preview will be optimized in the next version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/261484b67d4f865bb6050a7e31376a92bccc84e0.jpg[/img]

Optimization

Talent Screen Optimization
Layout changes, talent point display improvements, and reduced long-press time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/89906d0bd23b5f70acbfcd76101a94592f9a3ed3.jpg[/img]

Monsters not participating in battle no longer trigger camera switches
They are now skipped directly.

Character Info Optimization in Battle
Increased recognition of status icons and provided more detailed status descriptions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/0af43950f48c4c57e406c0f0a9d9839edf312abf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/a06281d399e4d66db1d465cc28ab3daea47e6e05.jpg[/img]

Weapon Rune Stone Sorting and Operation Optimization
Unequipped rune stones now appear at the front.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/35042cd8bb663ae1db106628d0549b3c97649c0e.jpg[/img]

Celestial Wheel no longer pops up large information panels every time
The information display area has been reduced and will now stay on the panel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/11071801e834c158a6c94c65df7549a0a8a2ded7.jpg[/img]

Zhuyu renamed to Yihuan
Increased mobility and the range of the Charm skill has been increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/b9e7d759188fe32dc59bb60d2f1d328660289224.jpg[/img]

Tengshe's Poison Formation Range Increased
Basic poison damage has slightly increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/9d588ace07cbc223ce10a38b3998fe8558c97fa8.jpg[/img]

Yehun's strength growth reduced
However, the damage reduction of the Piercing Arrow has been decreased from 25% to 15%, and AOE ability has been strengthened.

Laige Bao's Great Stomach Talent now helps teammates restore spirit power.

Numerous adjustments to information and UI usability.

notes.title: Demo2.1 Update
notes.content:
New Additions:
Added a battlefield character details page. Players can click the icon or press the Tab key to open and view current battlefield character information.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/6ee31ed8496b2c2430bf54bd8bb567c93c2bbcb7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/a3c65f0aa956a9fad0874d74a994206804ef5e38.jpg[/img]

Added bulk purchase in the store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/4dd44531e67660b9f70c705211a187f77201f276.jpg[/img]

Added QE as shortcut keys for rotating the camera view.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed display bugs for CG cutscenes and UI under different resolutions.

Fixed an occasional bug where the progress bar would freeze during rune socketing.

Fixed the BUG where some UI had no sound effects.

notes.title: New Demo 2.0 Version Update - Complete Game Experience is Live!
notes.content:
New Version Content

The official game story and the first four chapters, offering approximately 4-5 hours of gameplay experience. With the addition of free exploration, you’ll discover the secrets of the world while collecting treasures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/0c56b3eb10bc75f10c063913e33e29752966168a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/87f2b1ca95e4fbf492973dd2a56b73429acea01a.jpg[/img]

Talent System
Each character has a unique talent system, allowing you to create the character build you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/209dabdd798fac6d613414dbed65c41f8a92f85b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/3a67931dbd83a0597172831f844f85c1ed4e5710.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/07ce2efdd37edfbd7dfd1de7ec8187f9cae76978.jpg[/img]

Main Weapon System
Strengthened weapons increase attributes and open slots for powerful runestones to be inserted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/80e9c0cfe660b7cacad098b487c4940816825703.jpg[/img]

Crafting System
Now you can search for recipes and various materials to craft the magic items you want. Crafted products will have rare levels, and luck plays a part—rarer items are more advanced, with a higher output probability by the end of the month, and, of course, stronger effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/e30db56a781a19fd1bb9f701b3cd7cf5664628ff.jpg[/img]

Runestone System
Various special effect runestones offer more choices and creativity for building your character’s abilities. By embedding runestones into weapons, and combining them with talents and teammates, you can now create the team you want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/00a6eccb587005f38fc704e58ba12b09a0279674.jpg[/img]

Battlefield Artifacts
In addition to potions, you can now use powerful magical artifacts on the battlefield, and with team skills, you can trigger even more combos!

Optimized Astral Wheel System & Destiny Points
Now, the effects of the astral wheel are more effective on the battlefield and can be used more easily by players to amplify their advantages. Destiny points can also be stored and exchanged for in-game currency after battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/04f7b53db0d15a7a5ad0836986aa74d230196ced.jpg[/img]

New Character Addition
The fox demon Zhu Yu joins the team. Zhu Yu is not only a beautiful companion on the battlefield but also a shopkeeper in the game. Her talent and runestone combinations can enhance the team’s resource acquisition abilities. If you enjoy managing your team’s resources, utilizing this character’s abilities can lead to an economic "nuclear explosion" early in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/f146a7397cdcd4a38941f736bfa5e3378c2741ae.jpg[/img]

Chronicle of Oddities
You will encounter many strange stories, interesting encounters, and rewards during your adventures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/c208ff6147fc298ee4c777a846ad541e00888324.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/542a72473dd2d56bff0b08a515f73111111fb53b.jpg[/img]

Welcome to Experience the New Version!
If you enjoy the game, please add it to your wishlist and join the community to share your valuable feedback!
Thank you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/4bfa4a5a073d2961f46e39d555a281a84cf0c9e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/f6ca48a0ddd21fd9e4fd3272ab97763822ed20ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/caab44f709b99698c6f9aa8e9d33a079cdd54ead.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo 1.2 Update:
notes.content:
1.Fixed the issue where the game would freeze after using certain skills.
2.Added buffering delays to the in-game battle camera movement, making close-up battle shots smoother.
3.Introduced a game speed-up feature, allowing the game to run at 1.25 to 1.5 times speed, along with an option to directly end the turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/a7cf67739c60819369c66d682c68f45dd1571eaf.png[/img]
4.Added Traditional Chinese in the language settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/6e553387051acdc7cc8118619fc0d826eb844f32.png[/img]
5.Adjusted the passive skill “Wolf Pack's Momentum” of the female protagonist Shuang Ling, expanding its range and strength from the nearest grid to the surrounding 3x3 grid.
6.Fixed some camera movement issues during cutscene playback.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
1.Added a damage preview feature, including follow-up attack preview, elemental restraint hints, and kill preview.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/c09754736679268c0de7861229f4f8659acb4d5d.png[/img]
2.The game tutorial will now pop up at relevant times during gameplay to guide new players with information related to their current situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/4b5d57ce1af8ea8a07fcb6b010112187cae76dd3.png[/img]
3.Fixed a bug where non-flying units could step onto high ground in certain situations.
4.Fixed a bug where the death animations for "Ha Jiang" and "Heng Jiang" were not playing, causing the camera to behave erratically during cutscenes.
5.Adjusted the interface entry for the Esc menu and the battle pause menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/ceeeced94e541c5c458d3662b2c7a5d73463735a.png[/img]
6.Fixed a bug where the right mouse button would not work in some situations.

More content is in development. We welcome you to try out the demo and share your feedback with us.

notes.title: Demo 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850874/c4670a7ba16d839b7c219861ecf20f3e935a32d6.png[/img]
1.Added multilingual support, including Japanese and Korean versions.
2.Adjusted difficulty, lowering the Nightmare difficulty level.
3.Fixed some problematic icon displays.
4.Fixed a bug where some character death animations were not playing.
5.Fixed a bug where the dialogue duration in the second stage could not be quickly skipped.
